source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 76 (SWAT, Quaternius 24-clip Animated Characters) points at poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. Stand-in: BlueSoldier_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt, the same CC0 pack, rig and clips as man-suit (no run, jump or death clip; no gun prop). Of the pack's two male soldiers (identical meshes, Soldier_Male in olive, BlueSoldier_Male in navy) the navy one is closer to police; recoloured as a black helmet and tactical vest over a navy uniform with black knee pads. It is a generic helmeted soldier, not a police model: no visor, badge or POLICE lettering, bare hands, and the boot tips share the skin material (they render skin-coloured). Height 1.8 m: chibi big-head proportions are the artist's, the overall size is a grown man's.
